fees.notes: International total payable fee for the entire programme per UOC official International Fees Structure (includes registration RM2,000, processing RM1,500, administration RM8,000/RM5,000 ODL, EMGS RM2,800 and resource fees); per-year amount not published. Source: https://cyberjaya.edu.my/admission/fees/international-fees-structure (fetched 2026-09-18)

requirements.general: Any of these: A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Bachelor's Degree Level): Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with a minimum CGPA of 2.75 or equivalent; OR A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 and less than 2.75 may be accepted subject to rigorous internal assessment; OR A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with a CGPA less than 2.50, but with a minimum 5 years of relevant work experience may be accepted subject to internal assessment; OR Others: Other equivalent qualifications recognized by the Malaysian Government and acceptable by the University. English Proficiency (For International Students): Minimum TOEFL score of 550 (pBT) or 80 (iBT) or IELTS score of 6.0.
